name: Sweet 'n' Sour Pork with Broccoli, Carrot & Bell Pepper over Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
3 yellow bell peppers
6 medium carrots
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Trim green onions and mince the white parts; add to the bowl. Cut green parts crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a plate (leaving drippings in the pot) and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground pork sausage

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place ketchup, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup ketchup
¾ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the sausage is done, return the pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 6 minutes.
When the veggies are done, return cooked sausage to the pot; add sauce, stir to combine, and cook until sauce is warmed through and sausage is coated, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, sweet 'n' sour pork, and veggies between plates or bowls; top with reserved green onions. Enjoy!
